title: Department of Computing PhD (2027 entry)
institution: Imperial College London, Department of Computing
about: Imperial's Department of Computing PhD for April and October 2027 entry has deadlines of 1 December 2026, 1 February 2027 and 1 April 2027 (the 1 October 2026 round has passed). Decisions run from 15 February to 15 July 2027.
requirements: Applicants are expected to have a First Class or Distinction Masters level degree, or equivalent
Overseas candidates who need funding are advised to apply by the October and December deadlines

upskill.name: the AI Foundations Academy page
